messages:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to finalize the pilot acceptance signals + launch rubric for the upcoming partner pilot. Goal: catch regressions early, surface commitment signals, and have clear rollback gates.

mike: Can you enumerate the signals you want captured? I'll map them to dashboards and telemetry.

elaine: Top candidates: 1) engagement: >=3 sessions/week or >=2 active devs per partner, 2) satisfaction: post-run NPS >=6, 3) feature adoption: using private VPC or model pinning, 4) quality regressions: eval set hallucination rate delta >+5% (weekly). Commitment signal = signed MOU or trial activation within 30 days.

kai: For the survey: keep it 3 Qs max. Include a hidden `prompt_id` in payload so we can tie to evals. Example payload snippet: `{"q1":"likert_satisfaction","q2":"issue_report","q3":"would_recommend"}`

nina: Add a freeform "primary ask" field in onboarding so CS can route feature requests. Cadence: weekly partner digest + monthly deep-dive (30m).

mike: On infra side I'll create a `pilot_health` composite metric (tokens/sec, median latency, 5xx rate). Also will add a binary `regression_flag` if eval metric drifts > threshold.

elaine: Draft launch rubric (proposal): must meet any 3 of the 4 core signals for at least 2 consecutive weeks; zero unresolved critical regressions; >=1 committed partner (MOU signed); docs + onboarding checklist published.

nina: Rollback / pause criteria suggestion: sustained latency SLO breach >2x baseline for 24h OR error-rate spike >10% sustained for 12h OR negative NPS trend (2 consecutive lowers) -> auto-pause + notify partners.

kai: UX: add an in-console CTA "Give Quick Feedback" that opens the 3-question survey (one-click). Keep wording non-technical for partners.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: pilot onboarding template v3 deploy on 2026-04-01.

elaine: Action items / owners: mike -> add `pilot_health` card + `regression_flag` (due Tue); kai -> CTA & survey wireframe (due Thu); nina -> partner digest + onboarding freeform field (due Fri); I'll update rubric doc and send to legal for MOU template.

mike: 👍 will do.

nina: +1, will draft digest.

kai: lgtm, I'll prototype the CTA in the console.

elaine: No objections, will post updated rubric tomorrow in #product and schedule a 30m alignment with CS + Eng next week. @here — leaving this thread as the canonical thread for pilot signals & launch gates. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
